journey.start_rule: client_start_date (Jira): for issues created before 1 Jun 2026, the issue due date, or the issue created date + 4 days when no due date is set; for issues created from 1 Jun 2026, the Pipedrive won date. won_clients_master falls back to the won date when no Jira start exists and labels it 'Pipedrive Fallback'; fallback dates are not confirmed starts and are excluded from starts and cohorts.

drivers.population: won engagements with a confirmed Jira start

offers.source: Onboarding questionnaire (Form Responses 2), column AA: self-reported experience submitting real-estate offers before STRSearch

under_contract.label: Under contract
under_contract.treatment: Collected at closing, timed by historical UC → CLOSED durations

scheduled.label: Closing scheduled
scheduled.treatment: Collected on the scheduled closing date

noprop.label: No property yet
noprop.treatment: Collected on the date set by the timing slider

paused.label: Paused / Additional Service
paused.treatment: A share proceeds on the slider date; the rest refunds

post_close_no_date.label: Closed, date missing
post_close_no_date.treatment: Already closed per status: second installment treated as collected, not forecast again

no_jira.label: No Jira match
no_jira.treatment: Status unknown: contractual balance shown, not forecast
